summary: The Playwright artifact is syntactically correct, uses Playwright APIs properly, and includes the required test case ID in the test title. The assertion on the URL ensures navigation to the expected category page. Selector uses a data-test attribute which is reliable. No await is missing before asynchronous assertions. recommendations: Consider strengthening assertions by validating page content in addition to URL.
Ensure selectors remain stable and are aligned to test attributes.
